meta.title: Perry County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Perry County's 2026 budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance #2025-20 on Dec. 8, 2025 and filed with the state. Amounts are the ordinance's maximum appropriations, split into categories using the county's budget detail report. A few funds only budget transfers (for example $200,000 from the LATC Fund), so some dollars may be counted in two funds.

nodes.name: Other County Expense
nodes.note: The 'Original Budget' column of these group totals was not read by OCR; the 'Actual Balance' column, which prints the same numbers, was used.
